quick_start_1: In Settings → Outbound proxies, link a dedicated proxy to each account you automate, to lower the chance of tripping the platform's risk control
quick_start_2: In Calendar, write your first post: post to many platforms from one draft, adapt it per platform, schedule it, or save it as a draft first

faq_accounts_a: Each connected social media account counts as one. For example, 3 Xiaohongshu accounts and 2 Douyin accounts make 5 accounts.
faq_discount_q: Are there discounts for longer terms or more accounts?
faq_discount_a: Duration: {{durations}}; quantity: {{volume}}. The two discounts stack.
faq_change_q: Can I add accounts or change plans at any time?
faq_change_a: Yes. Added accounts are charged only for the days left until your current end date. Plan changes take effect immediately, and the remaining value of your old plan is converted into days on the new one.
faq_trial_q: Do I have to pay for the free trial?
faq_trial_a: No. Every team can try the Team plan free for {{days}} days ({{accounts}} accounts). No card needed and no automatic charges; when the trial ends, you go back to the Free plan.
faq_credits_a: AI replies, AI rewrites, AI image generation, browser automation and similar actions use credits each time they run. You get free credits every month, and buying a plan adds bonus credits worth {{p}}% of the amount paid (¥1 = {{rate}} credits). You can also buy credit packs separately or earn credits with the daily check-in.
faq_pay_q: How do I pay? Can I get an invoice?
faq_pay_a: Pay by scanning a WeChat Pay or Alipay QR code. For large orders, bank transfers and invoices, contact {{contact}}.

page_desc_pricing: Priced per social account: the Standard and Team plans start at 5 accounts, and you can add accounts one at a time. Quarterly, half-yearly and yearly billing and more accounts get discounts. 7-day free trial.
page_desc_privacy: How oksocial collects, uses and protects your data
legal_contact: Questions about any of this? Email us at
privacy_intro: oksocial is an online tool that helps teams manage social media accounts. This policy explains what data we process, why we process it, who we share it with, and how you can view and delete it.
privacy_data_account: Account information: your sign-up email, team name, team members and their roles. For your password we store only an irreversible hash.
privacy_data_login: Login sessions of social accounts: each social account you sign in to by scanning a QR code stays signed in inside its own separate browser on our servers, and its login credentials are kept only in that browser. We never see or store your social account passwords.
privacy_data_content: Content you create in oksocial: posts and drafts, media files, brand profiles, reply templates, monitored targets, automation settings and run records, and leads.
privacy_data_social: Data read from the social accounts you connect: comments, DMs, @mentions, and public post and account data, used for the Inbox, analytics and Monitoring.
privacy_data_usage: Usage records: sign-in times, IP addresses and browser information, used for security and troubleshooting.
privacy_purpose_body: Only to provide oksocial's features to you: publishing and scheduling posts, syncing and replying to engagement, generating reports, running the automations you turn on, sending the notification emails you need, and keeping your account secure. We do not sell your data, and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy_third_platforms: Social platforms: when you have oksocial publish, reply or take an action, the related content is sent to the platform concerned (Xiaohongshu (RED), Douyin, Weibo, X and others).
privacy_third_ai: AI model services: when you use features such as AI replies, rewriting, content creation and tagging, the related text (and any images you upload for processing) is sent to large language model providers for processing.
privacy_third_email: Email service (Resend): used to send activation, password recovery, invitation and notification emails.
privacy_third_payment: Payment services (XorPay, Stripe): they process orders only when you pay. We do not store your bank card information.
privacy_third_webhooks: Webhooks and group bots you configure yourself: notifications are sent to the addresses you specify, according to your settings.
privacy_storage_body: Data is stored on cloud servers we rent (Google Cloud, Hong Kong region). Sensitive settings such as account egress proxies are stored encrypted, and all data in transit uses HTTPS. Each social account uses its own browser, and accounts never share login sessions with one another.
privacy_retention_body: You can delete posts, media, monitors and automations in oksocial at any time, and you can disconnect social accounts; disconnecting an account deletes its browser login session. When you close your account, your team, social accounts and content are deleted; a small number of records that must be kept for security and financial compliance (such as payment orders) are retained for the period required by law.
privacy_rights_body: You can view, correct, export or delete your personal information, and you can withdraw your authorization for a feature (for example by turning off an automation or disconnecting an account). Contact us if you need help.
privacy_changes_body: When this policy changes in important ways, we will post the changes on our website and notify you by email.
terms_intro: By signing up for or using oksocial, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully before using the service.
terms_service_body: oksocial provides tools for managing social media accounts, including publishing and scheduling, an engagement inbox, analytics, monitoring, automations and AI content creation. The features actually offered on the website prevail, and we may change or discontinue some features.
terms_account_body: You must provide a real, working email address and keep your password safe. Team admins are responsible for inviting members and assigning permissions, and actions taken within a team are treated as actions of that team. If you discover that your account has been compromised, contact us immediately.
terms_rules_heading: Following platform rules and the law
terms_rules_body: The social accounts you connect belong to you. You must follow each social platform's user agreement and community guidelines, as well as all applicable laws and regulations.
terms_rules_automation: Platforms may treat automation features (auto-replies, likes, follows, comments and so on) as abnormal activity, which carries a risk of rate limiting, risk-control action or account bans. Whether to turn them on, and to what extent, is your decision, and you bear the associated risks. We recommend starting with review mode and assigning each account its own egress proxy.
terms_prohibited_content: Posting illegal, infringing, pornographic, violent, fraudulent or harassing content;
terms_prohibited_spam: Sending spam in bulk, inflating metrics, or manipulating public opinion;
terms_prohibited_accounts: Using other people's accounts without authorization, or using this service to attack or interfere with other people's systems;
terms_prohibited_api: Cracking, reverse engineering or abusing this service's interfaces.
terms_payment_body: The prices and benefits of paid plans and credits are as shown on the purchase page. Credits are used for pay-per-use features such as AI and automations and are deducted at the prices published on that page. For refunds, contact us; refunds are handled based on actual usage.
terms_content_body: Content you create or upload in oksocial belongs to you. You authorize us to store, process and send that content in order to provide the service. Please verify AI-generated content yourself before publishing it.
terms_liability_heading: Service interruptions and limitation of liability
terms_liability_body: We do our best to keep the service stable, but changes to social platforms, their risk controls, or failures of third-party services may make features temporarily unavailable. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for platform penalties, account restrictions or indirect losses.
terms_termination_body: You can close your account at any time. If you seriously violate these terms, we may suspend or terminate your use of the service.
terms_changes_body: When these terms change in important ways, we will post the changes on our website and notify you by email. Continuing to use the service after a change means you accept the new terms.
